data.body_html:
No licence? No problem. In Marbella, you can charter a luxury boat without any boating qualification – every rental includes a professional skipper who handles everything. This page gives you the concrete no license boat rental prices Marbella 2038, so you know exactly what you'll pay before you book. All departures are from Puerto Banús, and prices include fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and 21% IVA.

Whether you want a 2-hour spin along the Golden Mile or a full-day cruise to Cabopino, we have transparent rates for every budget. Let's get straight to the numbers.

No Licence Boat Rental Prices – Tier A (€749–€2,299)

Our most popular no-licence options are the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) and the Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax). Both are perfect for small groups and depart from Puerto Banús. Prices are all-inclusive:

  • 2 hours: €749
  • 4 hours: €1,399
  • 6 hours: €1,899
  • 8 hours: €2,299

Each charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, and VAT. No hidden extras.

No Licence Boat Rental Prices – Mangusta 80 (from €4,719)

For a larger group, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) is the ultimate no-licence choice. Available in white or grey, this yacht includes a free jet ski. Minimum charter is 4 hours at €4,719. Longer durations are priced on request via WhatsApp.

Same all-inclusive package: skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and VAT. Just bring your swimwear.

Other Boats – No Licence, Price on Request

Our remaining fleet does not have fixed hourly rates online, but you can request a personalised quote via WhatsApp. Boats include:

  • Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax)
  • Canados 86 (26m, 12 pax)
  • Pershing 46 (14m, 10 pax)
  • Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax)
  • Fairline Targa 12m (12m, 10 pax)
  • Maiora 26m (26m, 12 pax)
  • K80 (24m, 12 pax)
  • Lagoon 380 (11.6m, 10 pax)
  • Bandido (11.5m, 8 pax)
  • Red Tide (11m, 6 pax)
  • Speedboat (7m, 6 pax)
  • Mariah SX21 (6.4m, 5 pax)
  • Dubhe (8m, 5 pax)

Every boat departs from Puerto Banús and includes a licensed skipper – no licence needed.

Why No Licence Is Needed – The Skipper Advantage

Spanish maritime regulations require a licence for anyone operating a pleasure craft over certain power/size limits. By including a professional skipper in every charter, we bypass that requirement entirely. You and your guests simply relax, swim, sunbathe, and enjoy the Costa del Sol coastline. The skipper handles navigation, anchoring, and safety.

This is the standard model for boat rental in Marbella – no licence, no stress.

What You Get for the Price

Every no-licence charter includes:

  • Licensed, English-speaking skipper
  • Fuel for the entire trip
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks (chips, olives, nuts)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21%)

No extra charges for docking, cleaning, or crew gratuity (though tips are always appreciated).

Where You Can Cruise Without a Licence

From Puerto Banús, you can head west to the exclusive Sotogrande marina, or east to the cliffs of Cabopino and the Cala del Faro. Popular anchorages include Cala Cortés and the waters off the Golden Mile. The skipper will suggest a route based on sea conditions and your preferences.

Typical distances: Puerto Banús to Cabopino is about 5 NM (20 minutes), to Estepona about 10 NM (40 minutes), and to Sotogrande about 20 NM (1 hour 15 minutes).

How to Book a No-Licence Boat in Marbella

Booking is simple. For Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) and the Mangusta 80, you can book directly online with the prices listed above. For all other boats, contact us via WhatsApp for a custom quote. We recommend booking at least 48 hours in advance, especially during peak summer months (June–September).

All departures are from Puerto Banús. Arrive 15 minutes before your charter time. The skipper will greet you at the dock.

Frequently Asked Questions

Do I need a licence to rent a boat in Marbella?

No. All our boats come with a licensed skipper who handles navigation, mooring, and safety. You and your guests simply relax and enjoy the cruise. No boating licence or experience is required.

What is the cheapest no-licence boat rental in Marbella?

The most affordable option is our Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39 at €749 for 2 hours (all inclusive). For a longer day out, the same boats cost €2,299 for 8 hours. Both depart from Puerto Banús and carry up to 9–11 passengers.

How much does a Mangusta 80 cost without a licence?

The Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) starts at €4,719 for a minimum 4-hour charter. This price includes a free jet ski, skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and VAT. Two colour variants (white and grey) are available.

What is included in the rental price?

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). There are no extra charges – the price you see is the final price.

Can I rent a boat for just 2 hours in Marbella?

Yes. Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) are available from 2 hours at €749. For larger yachts like the Mangusta 80, the minimum charter is 4 hours. Other boats are priced on request via WhatsApp.

Which boats are available for no-licence rental?

Our entire fleet is available without a licence – from the Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) and Mariah SX21 (6.4m, 5 pax) to the Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) and Canados 86 (26m, 12 pax). All depart from Puerto Banús.

How many people can I bring on a no-licence boat?

Capacity varies by boat: up to 5 guests on the Dubhe or Mariah SX21, 6 on the Red Tide or Speedboat, 9–11 on the Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39, and up to 12 on most larger yachts (Mangusta 80, Ferretti 94, etc.).

Are there any hidden fees for no-licence boat rental?

None. The price you see includes skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and VAT. No docking fees, cleaning fees, or surcharges. For boats not listed with fixed rates, we provide a clear quote via WhatsApp.
